answer_sentences.text: No, a foreclosure charge should not be levied on Ramesh Kumar’s floating-rate home loan, because the RBI says banks are not permitted to charge foreclosure charges/pre-payment penalties on all floating rate term loans sanctioned to individual borrowers.
answer_sentences.quote: banks will not be permitted to charge foreclosure charges/ pre-payment penalties on all floating rate term loans sanctioned to individual borrowers, with immediate effect.

answer_sentences.text: The RBI’s 2014 circular also states that banks should allow borrowers the possibility of prepaying floating rate term loans without any penalty.
answer_sentences.quote: in the interest of their consumers, banks should consider allowing their borrowers the possibility of prepaying floating rate term loans without any penalty.
